outlook72h: Hawaii: Maintain high alert for flash flooding and mudslides as Tropical Storm Moke impacts saturated terrain; prioritize isolated communities and water systems. View Article Indonesia (Flores): Continued aftershock anxiety and landslide-related access issues likely to sustain displacement and shelter needs. Source Colombia: Transition from SAR to recovery continues; prioritize WASH, shelter, and essential services restoration, especially in remote/landslide-affected areas. View Article U.S. Midwest: Hazard persists in flood-damaged areas despite receding waters; monitor unstable structures, debris hazards, and localized severe weather. Source Wildfires (BC, Reno): Expect continuing evacuations and air quality deterioration as containment improves gradually; wind shifts could prompt new warnings. Source
regionalTrends: Americas: Concurrent large-scale emergencies-Colombia earthquake, Hawaii cyclone flooding and renewed storm threat, and significant wildfire operations (BC, Spokane, Reno).

South/East Asia: Strong monsoon/typhoon signal-Afghanistan flash floods; China's Guangxi extreme flood mortality following typhoon; Japan record rain impacts; Indonesia major quake in NTT province. Source
Compound risk: Hawaii illustrates cascading hazards-initial hurricane flooding, infrastructure damage, and then renewed heavy-rain/mudslide risk from a subsequent tropical storm. View Article
Wildland-urban interface: Evacuation complexity and structure loss grow where fires meet urban edges (Reno, Okanagan), increasing needs for shelter and rapid damage assessments. Source
